title: Meet This Month's Enablers
intro: They're our friends who feed our thrifting habit, which makes them our sponsors, and they keep the Trail rolling. Show them some love with a click.

enablers.name: Vinterest (Southside)
enablers.blurb: A local-favorite vintage mall packed with antiques, collectibles, records and so much more, with a welcoming atmosphere that keeps shoppers browsing.

enablers.name: The Latent Image
enablers.blurb: A monthly mail club from photographer Marc Ullom. Members get signed archival fine-art prints, a personal letter and a few small surprises in the mailbox.
